r=5.25%
second sum was invested at 9.25.

Let Principal amount = 100 Rs.
then 100+9%=109%=9810
1%=90
because trader wants to settle before 06 months, therefore he has to pay for 06 months less than interest for 06 months
=4.5%
i.e.4.5 × 90 =405
∴ Amount to be paid
=9810-405=9405Rs.

1%=90

=4.5%
यानी 4.5 × 90 =405
∴ भुगतान की जाने वाली राशि
=9810-405=9405रु.

questions.q_en: R lends some money to S on which S pays ₹1,7000 more to R. S lends the same money to T, on which T pays 8.5% more to S. What should be the minimum amount [in Rs] that S must borrow so that he does not incur any loss in the process?
questions.q_hi: R, S को कुछ धन उधार देता है जिस पर S, R को ₹1,7000 अधिक देता है। S, वही धन T को उधार देता है जिस पर T, S को 8.5% अधिक देता है। S को उधार लेने के लिए न्यूनतम राशि [रु में] क्या होनी चाहिए ताकि उसे इस प्रक्रिया में कोई नुकसान न हो?
questions.solution_en:
Let the amount of money that S borrows from R is x Rs.
∴ for no loss, 8.5% of the amount borrowed = 17000
∴ x × 8.5% = 17000
x = = ₹200000
